focus_areas: Legibility and structure of on-screen text/icons (dependent on OVD grounding).
Distinctness and labeling of keyboard keys (dependent on OVD grounding).
Geometric plausibility of side ports via depth mapping.
Mechanical plausibility of the sliding chassis connection.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'uncanny valley' effect in the UI design. Does the interface look like a real OS (Windows Mobile, PalmOS) or a hallucinated approximation? Check if the keyboard keys have any discernible characters or if they are just blank bumps. Use the depth map to definitively rule out or confirm side ports.
image_description: A silver, clamshell-style handheld computer (resembling a vintage PDA or early smartphone) with a slide-out physical QWERTY keyboard. The device features a color LCD screen displaying a graphical user interface with icons and a photo of a person. The casing appears to be plastic/metallic with rounded edges.
